name: Aaradhya Anil Jadhav
review: If you're a foodie and a Misal Fan, you should visit here. In terms of ambience it's a old school without Air Conditioner. Hygiene is questionable. But Misal is great. Even many great people had Misal here. And waiting is evident.
feedback1: the customer enjoyed the Misal.
feedback2: Many other diners also liked the Misal.
feedback3: the customer found the place lacking in hygiene and air conditioning.

name: Kunal Mhatre
review:
Naam bade aur darshan chote, this line perfectly fits this snacks centre.

We ate Misal, it was very average. You will find more tastier Misal than this on local stalls.

Don't go just because it is famous or it has nice reviews.

Not recommended at all.
feedback1: the customer found the misal average.
feedback2: There are better misals available locally.
feedback3: It is not recommended.

name: Gautam Kanvinde
review:
One of the famous misals stop in Thane,
The original place
They serve plenty of Maharashtrian food(mostly snacks) misal(normal/midium/extra spicy) batata vada sabudaana vada and other maharashtrian snacks,also during lunch thy serve poli bhaji dal rice

Mostly busy during weekdays as it's official govt canteen.
Opens at 7.30am
Cozy sitting
Buttermilk and lussi were okay as earlier thir taste was much better. Would prefer to order tea

Parking is big issue always... Park properly to avoid fines...or towing
feedback1: the customer enjoyed a variety of Maharashtrian snacks.
feedback2: The establishment is popular among locals.
feedback3: Parking can be challenging due to limited space.

name: Asish A
review: I heard about this place a lot and decided to give it a try. The wait time was around 20 mins for me, and the place was really crowded. I ordered medium spicy misal pav with dahi, and it was really good. Service was also very quick. The dahi was really balancing the flavours of misal. Though I personally felt the food was not something out of world, it might be personal opinion. Worth a try to check if you like it.
feedback1: the customer had a positive experience overall.
feedback2: The misal pav was well-received.
feedback3: The service was quick.

name: Tilak K
review: I had heard about this place from a lot of people, however, my experience was disappointing. I have had the best Misal Pav be it from Kolhapur, Nashik, Pune or Baroda. I also know that the pattern / taste / ingredients of each one of them is much different from each other, however I did not find it to that level. Maybe I visited on Sunday and it was crowded, but that shouldn't deteriorate their quality.
feedback1: the customer had a disappointing experience.
feedback2: Misal Pav was not as good as expected.
feedback3: Crowd might have affected the quality.
negative_kws: ['disappointing experience', 'best misal pav', 'crowded restaurant', nan, nan]

name: Kuldeep Kumar
review:
Idk why so famous... The taste was good but it was way too oily. I actually got it packed bcz of the rush, the line was very long and the waiting time was too high idk why... It's overhyped.
I got misal pav and 2 pav extra at 85rs so yeah you can try that once.
feedback1: the customer found the restaurant overhyped.
feedback2: The food was too oily.
feedback3: Long wait times due to high demand.

name: Ha Ma Jo
review:
Be ready to get rewarded with one of the most popular misal in Thane but after waiting for may be half hour on a open narrow steel staircase!
Generally place is crowded, even when service is fast. Staff is really cooperative.
Must try is obvious their misal. Also get Thalipeeth and may be buttermilk.
You can order extra spicy misal depending on your choice. taste has been consistent over the years.
feedback1: the customer enjoyed the restaurant's misal.
feedback2: The service was prompt despite the crowd.
feedback3: The staff were cooperative.

name: Chetan Negandhi
review: Most tasty Misal I have had. 3 levels of spice content available, bland, spicy and very spicy. Misal with Paav and must have Butter Milk. This legendary outlet has small sitting area and waiting time is high at peak hours.
feedback1: the customer enjoyed the most tasty Misal.
feedback2: Three levels of spice options were available.
feedback3: The restaurant has a small seating area and long wait times during peak hours.
positive_kws: ['tasty misal', 'varied spice options', 'butter milk essential', 'small seating area', 'long wait times']

name: Aaditya Asawa
review:
Good place but you may need to wait. So a better plan is to consider the peak time feature in the Google map.

Masala Papad: 4.5/5 (Worth it)
Misal: Best in Mumbai (Grape embassy of Nashik still tops)
Order buttermilk with misal, best combination.
feedback1: the customer found Masala Papad to be worth it.
feedback2: The Misal was considered the best in Mumbai.
feedback3: Buttermilk paired well with the Misal.

name: Sneha Devendra
review:
Me and my friends travel from very long distance just to have OG mamledar misal at thane
The perfect mix of spices and hot tarri brings the taste to the next level
This is my favourite misal spot in navi mumbai
Always Fully satisfied with the taste and fullfilness
Favourite combos :- Mamledar spl misal, taak, pineapple sheera
feedback1: the customer loves the restaurant's misal.
feedback2: The dish has a perfect blend of spices and flavors.
feedback3: It is the customer's favorite spot in Navi Mumbai.

name: SOURABH PATIL
review: Well first of all, I'm from kolhapur and misal from my place is top notch, incomparable to anywhere else. So, I've been in mumbai since 2 years and have tried various misal almost 5-10 misals. And Mamledar was definitely amongst the top of them all. I ate from the Tahasildar office outlet near Thane railway station. I had Taak(chaas) and coffee as well which were average. The taste was good. Quantity was less and ambience was not so good. In all I would say this was the best misal in Mumbai so far. If you want to eat the best in the entire country then visit Kolhapur.
feedback1: the customer enjoyed the misal very much.
feedback2: It was considered one of the best among many.
feedback3: The quantity was less.
positive_kws: ['top-notch misal', 'best in Mumbai', 'good taste', 'average drinks', nan]

name: Ajit Bhaskar
review: This is a legendary place for misal. Known to be spicy, fiery, the staff even asks you (which is a way of knowing how much heat you can handle). I chose the tikha. Unfortunately, that's the only thing I could taste, amidst a sea of oil. I found it hard to finish because of the latter aspect. The pav was lovely, but the misal sadly didn't work for me. I even tried to ask for extra rassa, and that also had way too much oil. So....unfortunately, this one is not for me. Price is reasonable and there is seating so ambience is comfortable.
feedback1: the customer did not enjoy their meal.
feedback2: The misal was too oily and difficult to finish.
feedback3: The tikha was the only dish they could taste.
negative_kws: ['spicy food', 'too oily', 'hard to finish', nan, nan]

name: Sangameshwar Barole
review:
Went with a lot of expectations but only to get disappointed!

Location:
Walking distance from thane railway station. They have a small roadside parcel counter, but dine in section is at first floor

Ambience ans service
Good ambience. Big enough dining area, Hygiene maintained. Super quick service

Taste:
This was the most underwhelming part. Misal was bland. To add some flavour, I asked them for tarri/rassa but that too lacked any real spices. (They charge extra for it) The only saving grace was Buttermilk.

Maybe this place has lost it's old charm/taste. Honestly, you would find the same (if not better) Misal pav at any random restaurant in Mumbai/Thane
feedback1: the customer found the taste disappointing.
feedback2: Misal was bland without additional seasoning.
feedback3: Buttermilk was the only redeeming factor.
negative_kws: ['bland food', 'lack of flavor', 'quick service', 'good ambiance', nan]

name: Tasty Traveler
review: Many people recommend Mamledar Misal near the Tahsildar office in Thane, but I really don't like the taste, and the hygiene is not maintained at all. They charge extra for the misal rassa, which is usually served free of cost at most places. The quantity and quality of the misal are not up to the mark; it's an overhyped place. The tables are not clean, the waiters are rude, there's a lot of rush, the floor is messy, and the tables are not cleaned properly. Considering the price, it's not worth trying.
feedback1: the customer did not enjoy the taste of the misal.
feedback2: The hygiene was poor.
feedback3: The service was subpar.

name: Venkatesh Jadhav
review: Below average misal ... There's no taste to the misal , it can get spicy if ordered but the flavours are very mild ... Heard a lot about it and hence tried ... Kinda disappointed
feedback1: the customer found the misal below average.
feedback2: The flavors were very mild.
feedback3: the customer was somewhat disappointed.
negative_kws: ['disappointing meal', 'lack of flavor', 'average taste', nan, nan]

name: sitikantha rath
review:
I tried Misal here on a weekend.
I loved it.
I opted a spicy one.
I could taste the flavour of all spices.
The spices make it special I believe.
Crowded in evening on a weekend though. Still worth having the misal at this famous eatery in Thane.
feedback1: the customer enjoyed their meal.
feedback2: The misal was flavorful.
feedback3: The restaurant is popular despite being crowded.

name: Manoah Johnson
review: Situated in the hustling thane railway station this mishal pav centre serves a really good mishal pav. Amitabh bachan's favourite mishal here in Mumbai he says. The buttermilk here is exceptional and one among the best I ever had . Lovely. Decent ambience as well.
feedback1: the customer enjoyed the mishal pav center.
feedback2: The buttermilk was exceptional.
feedback3: The ambiance was decent.

name: Vishal Rathod
review: A good iconic dine. Avoid ordering light Misal out of fear, at least take a medium one for genuine taste or else it'll taste as of any other Misal. Have a great time at this historic location only at this branch second to no other of theirs in terms of their service,taste and quality.
feedback1: the customer enjoyed a good dining experience.
feedback2: Avoid ordering light Misal; opt for medium instead.
feedback3: Service, taste, and quality are excellent.

name: Milind Salokhe
review:
Very well known for misal and we have visited only for eating misal and chai.
Their spicy misal (tikhat misal) and medium misal (tasted by my wife).
The taste is good, the spicy misal I liked for its spicy taste but the farsan is different than other places I have tried (misal at Aahar Kolhapur).
One should try the good misal and then a chai (soothing your senses of spicy misal)
feedback1: the customer enjoyed the restaurant's misal dishes.
feedback2: The misals were flavorful, especially the spicy one.
feedback3: The farsan varied from other restaurants.

name: Majithia Deep
review: From a very long time this place has embarked a repute to serve the best Misal but in actual the reality is bit different. Was supposed to be super spicy but seems catering to the changes they ask you first if you want it spicy or medium. Quantity is just ok and frankly I thought it's now resting on past laurels. Maybe it's just me but have tasted better or maybe my expectation was too high from all the hype. It's taste however seems to be a favorite judging from the queue that was forming outside.
feedback1: the customer had mixed feelings about the restaurant.
feedback2: The misal was not as spicy as expected.
feedback3: The quantity was average.

name: appi k.
review: If you want to eat a missal here, wear 4 kg of gold or go to the Mercedes car. Because they treat you with your dress. My mom and I was sitting .. the guy said ... don't sit in the VIP sitting. We were given a place near the kitchen. My daughter is small and she could not smell the oil, so we changed the space. The guy came back and started saying "Don't sit here". I got angry and replied, "I'm going here." Then he calmed down. This was a really dirty experience ...
feedback1: the customer had a negative dining experience.
feedback2: The restaurant treated them poorly.
feedback3: The environment was dirty.

name: Vivek Saraswat
review:
This is famous outlet. Tried their flagship.. Spicy Misal Pav. Taste is good. Seving 2 Pav and Misal at 70. Additional rassa is on extra charge.
Queue is their for getting a seat, it will take 10 to 15 min waiting to get the space.
Overall can try while in thane.
feedback1: the customer enjoyed the spicy misal pav.
feedback2: The taste was good.
feedback3: The queue was long for seating.
positive_kws: ['spicy misal pav', 'good taste', 'long wait time', nan, nan]

name: Pushkraj K
review: Okay. Misal is okayish , you can find better Misal joints in Pune. The taste is mediocre, service was not that great, the waiter scolded us as we asked rassa vati and paav on different instances, he said we should have asked him to bring all the items at once. I mean not worth the hype and not bad as well. Good to go for one time
feedback1: the customer found the misal okayish.
feedback2: The taste was mediocre.
feedback3: Service was poor due to the waiter's attitude.

name: pranav marrar
review: Only Mamledar misal you can trust for taste. Tried few other franchises first and landed in to this one later. Enjoyed the taste, would recommend without the additional spicy curry (tarri).
feedback1: the customer enjoyed the taste of Mamledar misal.
feedback2: The restaurant is recommended by the customer.
feedback3: Additional spicy curry (tarri) is not recommended.

name: Niru K
review: Food quality has degraded. Mamledar misal was famous. Now the taste is bad. If this taste continues, I won't return for sure. Sad to see misal legend going down like this.
feedback1: the customer is disappointed with the food quality.
feedback2: Mamledar misal used to be famous but now tastes bad.
feedback3: If the trend continues, the customer will not return.

name: Harivansh Yadav
review: I recently tried the misal pav at this place, and it was absolutely delicious! The flavors were rich, and the spice level was just right - it was spicy enough to leave a tingling sensation but not so hot that it was overwhelming. However, the downside was the long queue - I had to wait for at least 30 minutes to get my food. Despite the wait, the misal pav was worth it.
feedback1: the customer enjoyed the misal pav.
feedback2: The flavors were rich and well-spiced.
feedback3: There was a long wait time.

name: Akshay Sanklecha
review:
We ordered Misal, Aluwadi and Butter Milk.
Butter milk was not good in taste
Other items were good.
You will always see a waiting queue near the restaurant, but waiting time is hardly half hour.
It's worth the wait
feedback1: the customer enjoyed their meal except for the butter milk.
feedback2: The waiting time was manageable.
feedback3: The restaurant is worth visiting.
positive_kws: ['good food', 'long wait times', 'worth it', nan, nan]

name: Aniket Upganlawar
review:
This is a pickup place more than anything else. Good part is that almost everything is kept ready so that service is quite fast.

Misal is good. I took the medium and honestly it wasn't that spicy.
feedback1: the customer enjoyed their meal at Misal.
feedback2: The misal was medium spiciness.

name: Gopal Patil
review: Place who maintains it's standards for a top notch misal. There are regular people who have been eating here since ages. Misal moderately priced and comes in a non spicy and spicy version. I liked the spicy one. Many more options available. Need to wait for sometime. Highly highly recommended if you are a misal lover.
feedback1: the customer enjoyed a top-notch misal experience.
feedback2: The misal was moderately priced and available in both non-spicy and spicy versions.
feedback3: Many customers have been enjoying the place for years.

name: Aarien Textile Limited
review:
It's a small place but they have 10 to 12 tables. We went on Sunday so there is a long line outside the restaurant. Misal pav has excellent taste.

Please note that there is no parking outside. It is better to park near that talao. From there it is 5 mins walk.
feedback1: the customer enjoyed the misal pav.
feedback2: There is a long line outside the restaurant.
feedback3: No parking available outside.
